## Intended session blocks

- what generative AI is good at and where it fails
- local constraints around sensitive data and infrastructure
- scenario-based exercises using real biomedical research decisions
- documentation, attribution and human oversight
- open discussion of uncertainty, misconceptions and edge cases

## Evaluation note

The workshop should collect feedback that improves both content and delivery. It should not be treated as a one-off presentation.
